requires.n: Soul Sister (Gain life when a creature enters)

4399-4770-6556--228.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Temur Battlecrier.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, the "Soul Sister" card triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and the Soul Sister trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Soul Sister trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
4399-4770-6556--228.notes:
The infinite lifegain, infinite lifeloss, and infinite energy counter results are only produced by specific soul sister effects.

If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

5170-5256-6132-8292.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Massacre Girl triggers, dealing 1 damage to target opponent and causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing a player to mill a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Massacre Girl trigger.
Resolve the Massacre Girl trigger, dealing 1 damage to target opponent and causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing a player to mill a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat.

240-574-647-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Vish Kal ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Vish Kal equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat from step 2.
240-574-647-5470.notes: Depending on how many counters this combo puts on Vish Kal, you can activate its last ability to kill some number of creatures.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

728-1123-6972.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Flayer of the Hatebound
When Flayer of the Hatebound dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Flayer of the Hatebound enters, it triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Flayer of the Hatebound
When Flayer of the Hatebound dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Flayer of the Hatebound enters, it triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve both Grimgrin abilities from step 1 and 4.
Repeat.
728-1123-6972.notes: If Flayer of the Hatebound starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

791-7841-8089.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is a multiple of 3.
791-7841-8089.description:
Activate Unspeakable Symbol by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

997-2393-2738-4871.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Sifter of Skulls, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1170-1329-1492-7895.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1170-1329-1492-7895.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Welding Jar.
Cast Welding Jar from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Little Bear.
When Little Bear enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

2021-2060-2313-2445.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

4770-5554-7824.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Treasure or Gold token.
4770-5554-7824.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {1}{W}.
Oltec Matterweaver triggers, creating two token copies of any Treasure or Gold token you control.
When Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, or two Golds by sacrificing them, adding {1}{W}.
Repeat.

884-3179-4399-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument.
Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument trigger.
Resolve the Defiler of Faith trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Ayara triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Oketra's Monument trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
When the Warrior enters, Ayara triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Ayara trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Ayara trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
884-3179-4399-4518.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

5231-7084-7705.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Thermopod ability.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Mole Man triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

2921-5571-7310--6.description:
Use Kitsune to give Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3899-4552-6753-7280.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Donatello.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

647-1061-4603.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is 4 or greater.
You have the city's blessing or control at least nine permanents.
647-1061-4603.notablePrerequisites: You are able to gain at least 3 life per turn.
647-1061-4603.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Maralen triggers, causing you to lose 3 life and search your library for Timestream Navigator and put it into your hand.
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
If you don't have the city's blessing, Timestream Navigator gives you the city's blessing.
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Gain at least 3 life.
Repeat each turn.

3814-4038-5963.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two mana-producing lands.
3814-4038-5963.description:
Activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Marvin using Argothian Elder's ability by tapping it, untapping the two lands.
Activate Marvin using Farmstead Gleaner's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Marvin.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

5475-5921-5970-6968.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Forensic Researcher.
Activate one of the Forensic Researcher tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Forensic Researcher token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

3525-7014-7069.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U} due to Tectonic Split
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, untapping Tectonic Split.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping North Pole Patrol.
Repeat.

141-780-6797.description:
Cast Supernatural Stamina by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Supernatural Stamina, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Supernatural Stamina.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Phantom Train abilities from step 5.

1557-1651-2750-5640.description:
Activate Memnarch by paying {1}{U}{U}, causing Siren of the Silent Song to become an artifact.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping it and Siren of the Silent Song, targeting Siren of the Silent Song.
Ertha Jo triggers, copying Clock of Omens' ability, targeting Clock of Omens.
Resolve both Clock of Omens abilities, untapping it and Siren of the Silent Song.
Siren of the Silent Song triggers, causing each opponent to discard and mill a card.
Repeat from step 2.
1557-1651-2750-5640.notes: You can tap a different artifact in place of Clock of Omens if desired.

67-1676-5670-6458-6917.easyPrerequisites:
Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
Your life total is at least 2.
67-1676-5670-6458-6917.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Reveillark.
When Reveillark dies, it triggers, returning Seedship Broodtender and Boss's Chauffeur from your graveyard to the battlefield. Boss's Chauffeur will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it equal to the number of creatures you control.
When Seedship Broodtender enters, it, Thunder of Unity and Boss's Chauffeur trigger.
Resolve the Thunder of Unity trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Boss's Chauffeur trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Boss's Chauffeur.
Resolve the Seedship Broodtender trigger, causing you to mill three cards.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Boss's Chauffeur.
When Boss's Chauffeur dies, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Citizen creature token for each +1/+1 counter on it.
When the Citizens enter, Thunder of Unity triggers that many times, causing you to gain that much life and each opponent to lose that much life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing a Citizen, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat step 12 two additional times.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{B}{G}.
Activate Seedship Broodtender by paying {3}{B}{G} and sacrificing it, returning Reveillark from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Reveillark enters, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.
67-1676-5670-6458-6917.notes: You must control an additional creature to get infinite +1/+1 counters on Boss's Chauffeur, infinite mana, infinite lifegain, and infinite creature tokens.

280-585-1399-1606.description:
Activate Unnatural Selection by paying {1}, causing Ley Weaver to become an Elf until end of turn.
Activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding {B}{G}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Golgari Rot Farm.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat from step 2

4798-5435-5632.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
4798-5435-5632.description:
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Ovalchase Daredevil triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Chalk Outline triggers. Holding priority, activate Dream Trawler by discarding Ovalchase Daredevil.
Resolve the Chalk Outline trigger, creating a 2/2 Detective creature token and a Clue token.
Repeat from step 2.

877-1374-5910-6573.notablePrerequisites: You've cast a commander from the command zone this game.
877-1374-5910-6573.description:
Cast Nameless Inversion from your graveyard, as it is a Knight card, by paying {0} due to Font of Magic and Morophon, giving a creature +3/-3 until end of turn.
If the creature has toughness 0 or less, the creature dies as a state-based action.
Repeat as desired.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with at least one +1/+1 counter on it

1495-2942-4120.description:
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting three +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Repeat as desired.
1495-2942-4120.notes: You may target a creature you control in step 2 to put +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.

510-2281-5686.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Mistmoon Griffin.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Mistmoon Griffin.
When Mistmoon Griffin dies, it and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Mistmoon Griffin from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Mistmoon Griffin trigger, failing to exile it as it is not in your graveyard and then returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

222-527-1322-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee, adding {G}.
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {B}{R}{G}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Selvala, adding {1}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

372-3378-5913.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Illusionist's Stratagem exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Pinnacle Monk exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-3378-5913.description:
Cast Illusionist's Stratagem by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian and causing you to draw a card
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Pinnacle Monk and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Pinnacle Monk trigger.
Resolve the Pinnacle Monk trigger, returning Illusionist's Stratagem from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Illusionist's Stratagem.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Pinnacle Monk and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

301-3967-5643.notablePrerequisites:
Putrid Goblin does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
You have had at least one Zombie enter the battlefield under your control this turn.
301-3967-5643.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Putrid Goblin enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your cotnrol this turn.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving it indestructible until end of turn.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-3440-4867-5256.description:
Activate Cormela by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant or sorcery spells.
Cast Demonic Gifts by paying {1}{B}, targeting Cormela.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Resolve Demonic Gifts.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Cormela.
When Cormela dies, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Cormela from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Demonic Gifts from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Cormela's power.
Repeat.

796-2440-3940-5231.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Zombies.
796-2440-3940-5231.description:
Cast Haze of Rage with buyback by paying {3}{R}.
Poppet Stitcher and Haze of Rage's storm ability triggers.
Resolve the Poppet Stitcher trigger, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Zombie you control.
Resolve the Haze of Rage trigger, copying Haze of Rage for each spell you've cast before it this turn.
Resolve each Haze of Rage, giving creatures you control +1/+0 until end of turn for each Haze of Rage and returning the original Haze of Rage to your hand.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Zombie, adding {R}.
Repeat.
If you control three or more Zombies as the combo begins, this combo nets infinite colorless mana.

1350-1494-4264.description:
Cast Altered Ego by paying {7}{G}{U}, causing it to enter the battlefield as a copy of Sage of Hours with five +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Altered Ego by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Altered Ego to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat each turn.

884-2438-2530-2577.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Gravecrawler, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard to the battlefield by paying {B}.
Ayara and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Ayara trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Repeat.

2034-3094-5159.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, targeting any artifact.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Mishra's ability, targeting Lithoform Engine.
Resolve the copy of Mishra's ability, creating a token copy of Lithoform Engine that is a 4/4 creature with haste named Mishra's Warform in addition to its other types.
Activate Mishra's Warform's first ability by paying {2}, and tapping it, copying Mishra's ability, targeting Lithoform Engine.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Mishra's Warform, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.

2173-2363-5220.description:
Cast Hangarback Walker either from your hand by paying {0} or from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Hangarback Walker enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Hangarback Walker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

1339-1940-5231.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-1940-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Liliana, Dreadhorde General triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Repeat.

1475-2034-2646.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one other modified creature with power one or greater.
Bloodspore Thrinax has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
1475-2034-2646.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing any other modified creature you control with power one or greater, adding {C}{C}.
One with the Kami triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to the sacrificed creature's power that each enter with at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1486-1651-3263.description:
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Magda and another artifact, targeting Magda.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Clock of Omens ability, untapping Magda.
Repeat.
